description: RayCAD STEP/IGES/DXF test corpus (PLAN.md section 11). Paths are relative to tests/corpus/: files/ is committed, cache/ is fetched by tools/corpus_fetch.py. See README.md.

fields.exporter: originating system and translator as recorded in the file header (STEP FILE_NAME, IGES global section, DXF 999 comment or application ids); null where the header records none
fields.units: length unit as recorded in the file; null where none is recorded
fields.expect: pass: the file is a valid model and import should give geometry; fail: import must report an error, without a crash or hang
fields.defects: known defects of the file, null if none are known
fields.redistributable: the licence allows redistribution; committed files (files/) must have true

nist-pmi.name: NIST MBE PMI Validation and Conformance Testing: PMI test case STEP files (CTC, FTC, STC)
nist-pmi.licence_statement: Works of the US Government (NIST), not subject to copyright in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105). The project page states that the test cases, CAD models and STEP files can be used without any restrictions; NIST asks for acknowledgement and does not allow its logo in promotional material. Checked 2026-11-18.

nist-d2mi.name: NIST Design to Manufacturing and Inspection (D2MI) project models
nist-d2mi.licence_statement: The README in the archive states the files were developed by NIST employees in the course of their official duties and are not subject to copyright protection (17 U.S.C. 105), i.e. public domain. Modelled in Siemens NX. Checked 2026-11-18.

occt.name: Open CASCADE Technology source repository, data/ folder (sample models)
occt.licence_statement: Distributed in the OCCT repository under its licence (LICENSE_LGPL_21.txt and OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt, copied to LICENSES/). The models were written by Matra Datavision Euclid.

freecad.name: FreeCAD source repository (example and test data)
freecad.licence_statement: Distributed in the FreeCAD repository under its licence (LGPL 2.1 or later; LICENSES/freecad-LICENSE.txt). Files that came into FreeCAD from CAx-IF test rounds or STEP-tool vendor demos were left out.

freecad-library.name: FreeCAD parts library (FreeCAD-library repository)
freecad-library.licence_statement: LICENSE-Assets in the repository: every part and exported .step/.dxf is licensed CC-BY-3.0; each part is copyrighted by its author, named in the repository's git history. Fetch-only here, so nothing is redistributed and no attribution text is needed in this repository. Parts whose names point to a vendor or brand were left out.

mayo.name: Mayo (CAD viewer) repository, tests/inputs
mayo.licence_statement: Repository licence BSD-2-Clause (LICENSES/mayo-LICENSE.txt). The user-submitted issue file #332 was left out.

ezdxf.name: ezdxf (Python DXF library) repository, example and integration-test DXF files
ezdxf.licence_statement: Repository licence MIT (LICENSES/ezdxf-LICENSE.txt). Files that look like third-party user drawings (commercial CAM system output, named persons, unknown application ids) and geographic data were left out.

build123d.name: build123d repository, tests/dxf and documentation models

cadquery.name: CadQuery repository, tests/testdata
cadquery.licence_statement: Repository licence Apache-2.0 (LICENSES/cadquery-LICENSE.txt). 1001.dxf (a drawing of unknown origin from Autodesk Mechanical) and MC 12x31.dxf were left out.

stepcode.name: STEPcode repository, parser test files
stepcode.licence_statement: Repository licence BSD-3-Clause (LICENSES/stepcode-COPYING.txt). Only small files written by the STEPcode developers are used; the CAx-IF and AP209 sample files in data/ were left out (origin not stated).

raycad-synthetic.name: RayCAD synthetic parts: tools/corpus_gen (OpenCASCADE) and tools/corpus_synth.py
raycad-synthetic.licence_statement: Generated by this project's own tools; same licence as RayCAD.

nist-mtc.name: NIST/MTC box assembly (the MBE PMI project's three-part box: box, cover, plate), AP242 STEP exports kept in NIST's AR-PMI repository on GitHub
nist-mtc.licence_statement: Modelled at NIST (file author a NIST employee) in a NIST/Manufacturing Technology Centre CRADA and published by NIST: the MBE PMI project page lists these CAD models and states that the test cases, CAD models and STEP files can be used without any restrictions; the dataset record (DOI 10.18434/T4/1503154) gives the NIST open licence (https://www.nist.gov/open/license). The STEP headers carry no third-party notice. The assembly file and the McMaster-Carr fastener parts were left out. Checked 2026-11-25.
